[LSCP.2.6.1] An `internal` schema has the `explicit` lifecycle
([LSCP.2.1]), except that only the engine asserts its facts. Rule LHSs may
pattern-match on them and rule RHSs may `withdraw` a fact they matched
([LSCO.4.5.9]); the compiler must reject an `emit` of an `internal` schema as
`DS_VALIDATE_INTERNAL_EMIT_FORBIDDEN`.
